_comment: Rules-test-only emulator config. Same rules file, different ports, so `npm run test:rules` never collides with — or clears — a Firestore emulator already serving local development on 8080. Moving firestore and storage was not enough: every emulator suite ALSO starts a hub and a logging socket, and those defaults are shared. When a dev suite already held them, this one reported `hub unable to start on port 4400, starting on 4401 instead`, warned that two instances were running for the same project, and then Firestore exited with code 1 — mid-run, taking one test file down while the rest passed. That is what an intermittent rules failure looked like. Every port this suite opens is pinned here, away from the defaults.
